description: Image Description: The image depicts the interior of a fast-food or casual dining restaurant. There are multiple digital screens mounted above a counter area. One of the screens displays a menu, possibly listing food items or specials. Beneath the screens, there is a stainless steel counter with kitchen equipment visible, including a fryer and possibly a grill. The back wall has white tiles with a few decorative tiles interspersed. There are various kitchen items, such as paper cups or napkins, on the counter.
